verdict.rationale: Granola documents a self-serve export of historical data via Settings > Profile > Generate CSV. The export includes each note's title, summary, transcript and basic details, and the docs explicitly position it for backups, migration and GDPR data portability. The REST API also offers programmatic access to notes, transcripts and AI summaries as an alternate extraction path. Missing for 10: evidence that the export covers ALL data (raw notes, folders/spaces, captured screenshots, chat history), richer open formats such as Markdown/JSON, documented account deletion or offboarding, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full export.
